findings.correction: Yet somehow, he didn’t fall. He couldn’t—not unless I let go of his fist.
findings.current:
Yet somehow, he didn’t fall.

That was only possible because I had to let go of his fist.
findings.defect: Reverses the causal mechanic: Hyuk stays up only because Taekyung is still holding the caught fist; falling is possible only if that grip is released. “I had to let go” makes release the reason he remains standing.
findings.rationale: 놔줘야만 가능한 일 attaches to collapsing, not to remaining upright. The next slap lands after that held pose; the draft’s obligation-to-release reading changes the action.
findings.source: 하지만 용케도 쓰러지지 않았다. 그건 내가 녀석의 주먹을 놔줘야만 가능한 일이니까.

findings.correction: The Third Young Master—I mean Squad Leader—must have a reason for doing this… right?
findings.current: Squad Leader must have a reason for doing this… right?
findings.defect: Omits Han Yeop’s audible self-correction from Third Young Master to Squad Leader, a hierarchy and characterization beat.
findings.rationale: 삼공자, 아니 조장님 is a pragmatic register shift, not filler. Dropping it flattens how he addresses Taekyung in front of Hyuk.
findings.source: 삼공자, 아니 조장님께서 다 생각이 있으셔서 그런 게 아닐까……요?

findings.correction: They passed through Jeongyang only a few two-hour periods ago and are headed for Honju.
findings.current: They passed through Jeongyang only a few hours ago and are headed for Honju.
findings.defect: 시진 was already rendered as two hours in this chapter; 몇 시진 is several two-hour periods, not “a few hours.”
findings.rationale: 한 시진 이동 was translated as two hours of travel. Treating 몇 시진 as ordinary hours understates elapsed time and breaks the chapter’s own conversion.
findings.source: 불과 몇 시진 전에 정양을 통과, 혼주로 향하고 있다고 합니다.

findings.correction:
*Seeing once, my ass—beating once is better than a hundred hearings.*

One beating really was better than explaining a hundred times.
findings.current: *I guess one beating really is better than a hundred explanations.*
findings.defect: Collapses the twisted proverb 백문이 불여일퍽 and the following gloss into one explanation, losing the 일견→일퍽 wordplay.
findings.rationale: The source first parodies 백문이 불여일견, then restates it. The joke is the swapped character, not only the gloss.
findings.source:
‘백문이 불여일퍽이라더니.’
백번 말하는 것보다 한 번 패는 게 낫구나.

findings.correction: Hyuk Mujin was caught up in a pointless hunger for glory
findings.current: Hyuk Mujin was consumed by useless ambition
findings.defect: 공명심 is thirst for glory/distinction, not generic ambition.
findings.rationale: The contrast is glory-seeking versus Han Yeop’s fear of fighting. “Ambition” blurs that motive.
findings.source: 혁무진 쪽은 쓸데없는 공명심에 사로잡혀 있고

findings.defect: 꿀꺽 is a gulp; glug is liquid pouring.
findings.rationale: Wrong onomatopoeia for a swallowed breath in a silent standoff.

findings.correction: The martial artist had belonged to the Sakju Branch, one of the ten or so branches of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.current: The martial artist had belonged to the Sakju Branch, one of the dozen or so branches of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.defect: 십여 개 is ten or so, not a dozen or so.
findings.rationale: Quantity is specified as 십여, about ten, not twelve.
findings.source: 무사는 태원진가에 속한 십여 개 지부 중 하나인 삭주(朔州) 지부 소속이었다.

findings.defect: Three drill calls become four. 헤쳐 모여 is one paired command, not two separate orders.
findings.rationale: Adding a fourth spoken command changes the drill sequence even if the parts of 헤쳐 모여 are individually recognizable.

summary: Critical fight mechanic reversal on Hyuk’s fourth blow; major losses of Han Yeop’s address correction, shichen duration, and the 백문이 불여일퍽 joke; smaller quantity, command, and register slips.
